title: The effect of fluid challenges in critically ill patients quantified with hyper-spectral imaging
summary: During illness, many patients require intravenous fluids. However, it is not always clear how much fluid is the right amount. To determine this, blood flow in the hand will be measured using a camera. A total of 300 images will be be taken before and after the administration of an infusion. The aim is to investigate whether blood flow has improved as a result of the fluid administration and whether it is possible to identify which patients will particularly benefit from the administration before it is given.

interventions.name: Patients that clinically present with a need for a fluid challenge

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Indication for a crystalloid fluid bolus as fluid challenge
Exclusion criteria:
- No informed consent can be obtained
- Impossibility of measurements (e.g. hand prothesis)
- Age <18 years
